The '''Muunilinst Podrace''' was a [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] event held in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], at the outskirts of its capital [[Pilaan]]. It had six participants all funded by [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gambler/Legends|gamblers]] who made bets on the race's outcome. The podrace was won by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who's [[Nal Kenuun's Podracer|Podracer]] was provided by the gambler [[Nal Kenuun]].<ref name="Target" />
